definitions.gloss: start of construction, commencement of work
definitions.explanation: The beginning of construction work on a building, road, or other structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{着工|ちゃっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Construction on the new building starts next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天候不良|てんこうふりょう}→天候不良：23438_tenkoufuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{着工|ちゃっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The start of construction is delayed due to bad weather.

examples.japanese: {着工|ちゃっこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧2⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: It is expected to take about two years from the start of construction to completion.

notes:
USAGE:
{着工|ちゃっこう} is used in news, real estate, and construction contexts. It marks the official beginning of physical construction work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着工|ちゃっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to begin construction)
- {着工|ちゃっこう}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧ (scheduled construction start)
- {着工|ちゃっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (construction start is delayed)
- {着工|ちゃっこう}{式|しき} (groundbreaking ceremony)

CONSTRUCTION TIMELINE TERMS:
- {着工|ちゃっこう} (start of construction)
- ⟦{竣工|しゅんこう}→竣工：16491_shunkou⟧ (completion of construction)
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧ (handover to the client)
